question: How do you structure a scalable Vue 3 app?
shortAnswer: Feature modules with routes, composables, components; shared UI kit; Pinia domains.
detailedAnswer: Colocate tests. Enforce public API boundaries between features.

question: Container vs presentational components in Vue?
shortAnswer: Containers fetch/orchestrate; presentational receive props/emit events and use slots.
detailedAnswer: Improves reuse and testing. Don't be dogmatic for tiny views.

question: When choose Nuxt vs plain Vite+Vue?
shortAnswer: Nuxt for SSR/SSG, file routing, conventions; Vite+Vue for simple SPAs or custom setups.
detailedAnswer: Nuxt accelerates product apps with SEO needs. Understand lock-in/conventions.

question: Handling API clients cleanly?
shortAnswer: Thin API module, typed DTOs, map to view models, central error handling.
detailedAnswer: Composables/stores call API—not raw axios in every component.

question: Microfrontends with Vue — considerations?
shortAnswer: Shared design tokens, routing ownership, bundle duplication, team autonomy.
detailedAnswer: Prefer modular monolith unless org constraints demand otherwise.

question: Error handling strategy across the app?
shortAnswer: Global error hooks, route-level boundaries, user-friendly toasts, logging pipeline.
detailedAnswer: Don't swallow errors in composables silently.

question: Design auth flow architecture in Vue.
shortAnswer: Auth store, router guards, token refresh interceptor, secure storage choices.
detailedAnswer: Keep tokens out of localStorage if threat model requires; prefer httpOnly cookies when feasible.

question: Lead: migrating a Vue 2 app to Vue 3?
shortAnswer: Build/tooling first, compat build if needed, replace filters/global API, Vuex→Pinia, test critical paths.
detailedAnswer: Incremental migration beats big bang. Train the team on Composition API.
